rationale: Repo-grounding audit at reviewed commit 2b437081 (which differs from the spec's stated citation base 06273a19 by the spec.md commit only, so all code citations transfer). I re-derived every priority chain against the tree rather than trusting the document. The #220 chain verifies exactly: resolve.go:57-67 returns ModeIdle when no epic exists; state.go:80-97 takes Mode from resolve.ResolveMode and uses phase.ResolveContextFromDir only for ActiveBead; derive.go:568-579's WorktreeSpec branch sets ModeSpec ('spec worktree without epic -> spec mode') and :588-597's WorktreeMain branch leaves Phase empty for >1 specs; instruct_tail.go's emitInstruct falls back to Focus{Mode: ModeIdle} when ctx is nil OR ctx.Phase is empty. I reproduced the headline claim live from this worktree: mindspec state show printed {"mode":"idle","activeSpec":"128-lifecycle-verb-state-honesty","specBranch":"spec/128-..."} - the self-contradictory output is real. The #186 chain verifies exactly: panelGate call at complete.go:750, the load-bearing-ordering comment at :710-715 quoted accurately, user CommitAll at :815, FormatResult at :1378-1408 with the ModePlan 'Remaining beads are blocked' branch at :1395-1400; gate.go:280-286 is the stale-SHA Block. The #248 chain verifies exactly: warning emission inside derive.go:179-193 with the exact quoted text; plan.go:455 writes mindspec_phase=implement (and the historical :424 citation at 09f62bd9 checks out - genuine line-drift-only note); repair.go:189-191 merge-writes detail.Derived unconditionally with no backward guard and no force flag registered on the command; derive.go:370-371 (first claim -> implement), :387 (all-open -> plan), :379-384 (some-closed -> implement), :505 (DiscoverActiveSpecs pre-080 fallback) all exact. The R6 residues verify exactly: runEmitOnly(specFlag, args) at next.go:75 never receives pick (read at :47, registered at :558); positional emit-only uses FetchBeadByID at :406-412; the containsSpecID title filter at :176-184 and :431-438; items[0] unconditional at :444; SelectWork out-of-range at select.go:25-29; SelectWorkByName exact-first/suffix/ambiguity at :42-93; beads.go:38/:54 wrap with %w of exit-status error; bdcli.go:443-455 tracedOutput uses cmd.Output() so stderr lands in ExitError.Stderr and is discarded. The shipped-item strikes verify: plan.go:370-372 warning text, :673-693 work_chunks dep wiring with the AC-20 surfaced failure, doctor/beads.go:283-317 version floor, :319+:337 schema-drift regex, checkMultipleBdOnPath at :393-402, release.go:63-65, impl.go implAdoptCmd with required --reason and --attest-unverified at :44-72. Doc/template claims verify: idle.md:44-48 Available Actions verbatim, review.md:40, grep -rn adopt internal/instruct/ is genuinely empty, merge-safety.md:75+ names the exact adopt invocation. ADR quotes verify verbatim: ADR-0041 :82-84 ('deliberately validate the resulting committed bead tip *after* this subphase'), :91 ('load-bearing in both directions'), :105 (Reconcile 'Never a rollback'), :144 (section 2 'Forward-reconcile, never rollback'); ADR-0037 :335 (section 4 staleness), :535 under '## Decision Details' (the grill's section correction is accurate), :590 (rejected warn-downgrade); ADR-0025 decision item 1 quote verbatim at :32; ADR-0023 :98 (no-epic -> spec first row), :107 (superseded edge row), :195 (single state authority), :204 (decision point 6). Settled fact 3's test name exists at internal/harness/scenario_contract_hardening_test.go:44. The three fresh-phase.Cache call sites named for the up-to-3x warning claim exist (resolve.go:53, target.go:106, the context path). Only two citations drifted, both minor line-number offsets that change no conclusion: the ADR-0023 spec-095 amendment row is at :140 (spec cites :142 in four places), and select.go's 'not found or not ready' error is at :92 (spec cites :97). No behavioral characterization misreads the code it cites. This is the most accurately grounded spec document I have audited in this repo; the two offsets are editorial.
concrete_changes_required: Correct the ADR-0023 amendment-row citation from `ADR-0023.md:142` to `ADR-0023.md:140` in all four occurrences (Background 'additional ADR staleness' paragraph, ADR Touchpoints ADR-0023 entry, OQ-4, and the first grill-record line). The row text and the ADR-agrees-with-code conclusion are correct; only the line number is off by two.

Correct the Background residue-#2 citation for the false 'not in the ready set (not found or not ready)' error from `select.go:97` to `select.go:92` (line 97 falls inside FormatWorkList's doc comment).

The superseded original row cited at :107 is exact, and the derive.go:379-384 agreement claim is correct, so OQ-4's resolution stands; this is purely a citation offset - notable only because the spec's citation-scope preamble promises refreshed-at-06273a19 accuracy and this line was not refreshed correctly.
